main.summary: Unsigned data contract for a signed common-identification artifact.

property.name: Id
property.summary: Stable unique identifier for the common-identification artifact.

property.name: IssuerObjectId
property.summary: Directory-resolvable issuer object identifier used to locate the signer certificate.

property.name: SubjectObjectId
property.summary: Optional directory-resolvable subject object identifier carried by the artifact.

property.name: CreatedAt
property.summary: UTC creation instant for the artifact.

property.name: NotBefore
property.summary: UTC lower validity boundary for verification.

property.name: ExpiresAt
property.summary: Optional UTC upper validity boundary for verification. Null means no expiration boundary.

property.name: Purpose
property.summary: Required stable purpose token for verifier-side purpose checks.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Create common-identification data using the current version.
method.param: Optional lower validity boundary. Null uses the resolved creation instant.
Optional explicit data identification. Null creates a new .
method.returns: Data instance using the current version.

method.name: CreateSecurityObject
method.summary: Create common-identification data from an issuer security object using the current version.
method.param: Required issuer identification supplying the object identifier and thumbprint.
Optional lower validity boundary. Null uses the resolved creation instant.
Optional explicit data identification. Null creates a new .
method.returns: Data instance using the current version.
